# Live console

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Run a live session from a stage plus side panels that act on it in real time. Workbench edits records; a console runs a session. Build your own on kit Workbench regions; there is no generator yet.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: ui-page.live-console`.

Kit: @kit/ui Workbench, @kit/ui Section, @kit/ui Collapsible, @kit/ui ButtonGroup, @kit/ui InertiaAction, @kit/ui EmptyState.
- `Workbench` from `@kit/ui` for the console: The stage and its panel regions (props: workbench-key, label).
- `Collapsible` from `@kit/ui` for the panel: One side panel in the stack (props: title).
- `EmptyState` from `@kit/ui` for the no session: The ready or empty state while no session is open (compact inside a panel) (props: title, actions, compact).
Checks: none. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Built on kit Workbench regions: the stage plus a panel stack of Sections or Collapsibles, with named actions in ButtonGroups. No hand-rolled layout.
- One realtime writer per session, held by a lock or lease.
- A documented keyboard transport map, with its keys announced in the help.
- A ready or empty state (kit EmptyState) while no session is open.
- Live counts sit in polite aria-live regions.
- Frames relayed to other screens carry only public fields; a test proves private totals and names never reach a public screen.
- Presenter-only authorization, re-checked on every action.

Related: `ui-page.workbench`, `ui-page.stage-display`.

Graduates: Graduate to a kit LiveConsole layout when a second app needs it.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Which workflow page?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.live-console` to see its siblings.
